headout-home:zooming-inputs.why: The search input is set under 16px on the phone layout.

airbnb-home:low-contrast.why: Pale grey secondary text is under 4.5:1, but the share swings from 4% to 13% between measurements of this frozen copy (its layout settles at different heights), so the size of the problem is not known.

airbnb-home:static.why: Frozen-copy artefact, confirmed: the live page measures 71% of buttons responding to hover against 14% on the frozen copy.

tiqets-home:hero-takes-fold.why: The phone hero is 57% of the first screen: larger than the others', within reason.

booking-home:competing-actions.why: Register and Sign in sit side by side with the same white fill in the header. Minor.

booking-home:text-on-photos.why: Product titles and ratings are drawn on the photos of the 'Recommended' cards.

booking-home:low-contrast.why: The boxed 'Search' label is white on Booking blue and reads fine; pixel sampling over the button edge misjudged it.

booking-home:no-focus.why: Not confirmed either way: 67% on the frozen copy, 71% on the live page, which is just inside what the tool tolerates. Counted as false.

musement-home:low-contrast.why: Card descriptions are pale grey at 3.9:1, under the 4.5:1 minimum. The live page measures the same, so it is not a frozen-copy artefact.

musement-home:equally-loud.why: 37% bold on the phone layout against 5–21%: heavier than the references, not broken.

headout-listing:zooming-inputs.why: Same input as the home page.

headout-listing:noisy-type.why: Nine sizes on the phone layout against five to eight.

tiqets-listing:nothing-to-browse.why: 32 cards against Headout's 71: shorter, still a full page.

tiqets-listing:hero-takes-fold.why: A third of the first screen is the city banner.

tiqets-listing:soft-images.why: The city banner and several tiles are served smaller than they are shown.

musement-listing:low-contrast.why: The same pale grey card descriptions at 3.9:1; identical on the live page.

musement-listing:no-focus.why: Checked by pixels on the live page: the date, category, filter and 'view more' buttons and the sort select look the same focused and unfocused.

musement-listing:static.why: Checked by pixels on the live page: none of the five buttons tried changes when pressed. Minor.

airbnb-detail:low-contrast.why: A line of pale grey text under 4.5:1. Minor.

airbnb-detail:static.why: Frozen-copy artefact: the same buttons as the home page, which respond on the live page.

tiqets-detail:static.why: Checked by pixels: the four date buttons do not change when pressed. Minor.

booking-detail:broken-images.why: Frozen-copy artefact: one picture did not survive freezing.

booking-detail:buy-below-fold.why: At 1440 the first screen shows title and gallery; the price is in the ticket panel below.

musement-detail:buy-below-fold.why: At 1440 the price sits under a full-width photo, below the first screen.

musement-detail:low-contrast.why: Pale grey text at 2.7 to 3.9:1; identical on the live page.

musement-detail:no-focus.why: The main 'Check availability' button and the chat button show no change when focused; identical on the live page.

musement-detail:few-photos.why: One large photo at the top against four or five on the references.

tiqets-listing:no-focus.why: Checked by pixels: the carousel 'Next' and 'Show more' buttons show nothing when focused.

tiqets-detail:no-focus.why: Half the controls tried at 1440 show no change when focused.
